police.speaker: Detective Morris
police.text: Morris finds the station was searched minutes before they arrived.

signal.speaker: Amara
signal.text: Amara isolates a second signal, moving beneath the village rather than across it.

alone.speaker: David
alone.text: David discovers fresh fingerprints on the hatch, small enough to belong to a child.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Amara traces the signal to a shuttered relay station. Three phones there repeat the same call, each with a different timestamp.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: One recording contains Ethan humming the tune Amara used to calm him. The final note is cut off by a metallic slam.

dialogues.speaker: Victor
dialogues.text: A new message arrives from Victor: "Good. Now stop asking the wrong question."

choices.label: Bring Morris to secure the relay
choices.impact: Morris can secure the relay station, though a formal search may make the caller move.
choices.response: Morris: I will keep the station covered while you check the recording.
choices.speaker: Detective Morris

choices.label: Triangulate the original recording
choices.impact: Amara can isolate the signal beneath the village, but it may disappear if Victor changes phones.
choices.response: Amara: I will trace the second signal now and keep the line open.
choices.speaker: Amara

choices.label: Enter through the service hatch
choices.impact: David can enter through the hatch before anyone clears the station, with no backup inside.
choices.response: David: I will check the hatch first. If it is a decoy, I will get out.
choices.speaker: David

metadata.episode: A continuing rescue mystery; the final clue opens the next episode.
